title: Great for multi-cat homes!
text: Every box so far has had at least 3 toys that each cat enjoyed (overlapping or not). I understand that many cats have different personalities and prefer different toys/treats. I enjoy that this subscription allows me to try out many different types of toys/treats for quite a bit cheaper than my local pet stores. My favorite part has to be the handcrafted toys that they include, and the themes! My three cats (age 1-3 years) all have found something to love in each box, and it keeps me from buying too many new toys "because they're probably getting bored with the old ones."
label: positive
